info.title: 语学星 v2 API Contract
info.description: Phase 1 API 的 canonical 契约基线。外部调用只经 Gateway 的 /api/v1 边界；JSON 是 API 单一事实源，详细业务域接口按同一 envelope、错误、分页、幂等、追踪与版本约定增量接入。

servers.description: 本地 API Gateway 固定端口；外部 API 的唯一入口

correlation.serverBehavior: The gateway accepts a valid client request ID or generates a replacement; every response returns the final request ID and trace ID.

writeIdempotency.binding: The server persists the request-body digest and first terminal response for the key scope.
writeIdempotency.replay: The same key and digest returns the original terminal response; the same key with a different digest returns HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
writeIdempotency.writeOperations: POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE declare x-idempotency; required writes reference IdempotencyKeyRequired.
writeIdempotency.exceptionRule: An exception is allowed only for a non-persistent operation whose response intentionally must not replay a prior credential. It must name the owner, explain the safe behavior, and cannot bypass idempotency for a domain command.

pagination.stability: A cursor is opaque, server-issued and bound to its filter/sort snapshot; clients must not decode, edit or reuse it with different filters.

400.meaning: The request syntax, required headers or request parameters are invalid; business validation of a well-formed body uses HTTP 422.

401.meaning: Credentials are missing, invalid, expired or revoked; clients may perform one controlled refresh only where a refresh credential is valid.

403.meaning: The principal is authenticated but the server-derived policy denies the action. 401 and 403 must never be represented as an empty result.

404.meaning: The requested resource does not exist or is intentionally hidden by the applicable visibility policy.

409.meaning: The request is syntactically valid but conflicts with current state, an optimistic version or an idempotency binding.

422.meaning: The JSON shape is understood but domain validation rejected one or more safe, field-addressable values.

429.meaning: A gateway or owner-service rate limit was exceeded; Retry-After is required and clients must back off.

5xx.meaning: The server failed or an upstream dependency timed out. Error details must remain safe for clients and must not expose secrets, stack traces or protected domain data.

deprecationHeaders.rule: A deprecated external operation returns RFC 9745 Deprecation, an RFC 8594 Sunset not earlier than the deprecation date when retirement is scheduled, and a Link relation rel="deprecation" to migration guidance. Deprecation alone does not change operation behavior.

migration.legacyEnvelopeRule: Every active /api/v1 operation uses the canonical success, cursor-page and error envelopes. B1-B13 response and envelope components are compatibility-only payload definitions and must not be referenced as an operation-level envelope.

B9LearnerProfilePatch.description: 只提交可由学习者修改的字段；principalId、tenantId、role、owner 和权限事实由服务端派生。

B9LearnerTargetUpsert.description: 目标命令不接受 tenantId 或 owner/principal 字段；目标始终绑定到已验证主体。

B9LearnerPreferencesPatch.description: UI locale、content locale、主题和无障碍设置分开持久化；contentLocale 不得覆盖 UI locale。

B9PrincipalId.description: 由 IAM 映射的不可变 principal；客户端不能提交或覆盖 owner/tenant 事实。

B9Problem.description: Compatibility error payload for existing B9 operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

B9StateVersion.description: 由服务端递增的聚合状态版本；不是客户端可自由生成的时间戳。

B9ContentEpoch.description: 内容发布/下线/权利变化后单调递增的缓存失效 epoch。

B9ExpectedStateVersion.description: 乐观并发写入的期望版本；新聚合尚未持久化时允许使用 0，服务端成功写入后返回从 1 开始的 B9StateVersion。

B10SubjectRefHash.description: Synthetic or irreversible subject reference hash; raw identity is never part of this adapter contract.

B10RuleContract.description: Protected grading contract metadata. It is not an answer key and is never emitted in integration events.

B10AssessmentContentSnapshot.description: Assessment-only snapshot. Content service remains the owner of question definitions and protected rule references; assessment does not maintain a content master table.

B10CreateAssessmentSessionRequest.description: The client may request a content version but cannot provide tenant, owner, role, score or grading rule facts.

response.description: Protected candidate response. It is read only by the scoring boundary and is not written to Outbox, logs or analytics.

B11Error.description: Compatibility error payload for existing media and notification operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

checksumSha256.description: 只传校验摘要；媒体对象不在 API 响应中。

reference.description: 短时授权引用；不得写入日志或事件。

payloadHash.description: 只传 hash，不传离线原文。

B12Error.description: Compatibility error payload for existing gamification, social and notification operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

B13Problem.description: Compatibility error payload for existing commerce, admin and analytics operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

code.description: 仅通过 TLS 短暂传输，服务端只保存 hash，日志和事件禁止记录原文。

token.description: 一次性短时确认令牌；仅允许通过 TLS 进入内存请求头，不得写入日志、数据库、URL 或客户端持久化。

password.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.
TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; optional native credential; Web sends HttpOnly cookie; 禁止日志或 Web storage 保存。

resetToken.description: TLS only; one-time credential; 禁止日志或明文持久化。

newPassword.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT; 禁止日志或 Web storage 保存。

refreshToken.description: TLS only; native-only rotated opaque credential; Web receives an HttpOnly cookie; 禁止日志。

deviceId.description: Optional public device id; server generates one when absent.

ApiResponseMeta.title: Canonical API response metadata
ApiResponseMeta.description: Mandatory response metadata for newly created or migrated public operations. requestId and traceId are also returned as response headers.

ApiCursorPageMeta.title: Canonical cursor page metadata
ApiCursorPageMeta.description: Cursor pagination metadata for every active list* operation and any other active operation declaring Cursor. nextCursor is null when there is no next page; hasMore must agree with nextCursor; cursor state must not be duplicated in data.

data.description: Operation-specific successful result. Domain schemas define this value; no caller-provided authorization fact is echoed as trusted data.

Operation-specific cursor-page data. Collection operations normally return an item array; compound synchronization receipts may return an object while all cursor state remains in meta. Each operation declares x-pagination with the canonical Cursor, PageSize and ApiCursorPageMeta references.

x-b8-compatibility.rule: Only iam-service may mint tokens. Compatibility routes are historical-only, cannot mint tokens, and fail closed.
